Overview and History
• Creator: Invented in 1881 by Heinrich Landesmann, who wrote under the pen name Hieronymus Lorm after losing both his hearing and later his sight. Fakoo +2
• Regions: Most commonly used in German-speaking countries, the Netherlands, the Czech Republic, Poland, and Georgia. Wikipedia
• Speed: Experienced users can reach speeds of up to 75 syllables per
